commits.message:
fix(palette): no-colour stays out of colour math; one rule for every producer (rich-palette-ufxd)

Review of #305: a #00000000 palette var reached darken, mix, contrastOn, ramp
and the rest, which composited it over black. They now refuse it at the one gate
every colour argument crosses, naming the fix. drawnOn and opaqueOnly own the
alpha-0 rule, so buildPalette and getThemeBaseColors agree with Palette; ink
refuses a transparent key; the rich-config palette chips show it on the
background it lets through.

fix(palette): a fully transparent palette variable draws no background (rich-palette-ufxd)

A theme's #00000000 (link-background, markdown-h*-background, footer-*-background
in 22 bundled themes) is Textual's "no background". The palette drew it onto
its own background like any tint, so bg (color "link-background") cut a
background-coloured box into a surface or panel row.

A Palette now hands an alpha-0 colour out unchanged, and a Style reads a fully
transparent bgcolor as no bgcolor, so a style added over another keeps that
one's background in both the SGR bytes and resolveLook.

fix(panel): Panel and empty content are byte-identical to Rich (rich-panel-blxr) (#304)

* fix(panel): Panel and empty content are byte-identical to Rich (rich-panel-blxr)

Empty text is one empty line, as Rich's Text.render yields Segment("") for
it: a panel's empty body and an empty table cell now draw Rich's content
line. Table title/caption keep Rich's `if self.title` skip; the traceback
frame block is one entry per frame, so a frameless report adds no row.

Panel cuts its segments where Rich does: an unlabelled border row is one
run; a title or subtitle sits between corner-and-rule and rule-and-corner
runs, centred in width-4 and dropped at width <= 4; the content line is
padded to its canvas before the right padding's own run; a vertical padding
row is one blank run. A fitted panel widens to hold its title.

Pinned against Rich 9d8f9a3 in panel.test.ts "Panel as Rich draws it"; the
table.test.ts footer divergence is replaced by the reference bytes.

* fix(panel): labels, declared widths and empty titles follow Rich (rich-panel-blxr review)

High-pass findings, each confirmed against Rich 9d8f9a3:
- a newline in a panel/rule title reads as a space (Rich's _title)
- a declared width is a ceiling: expand=False fits inside it, and a title
  widens past it up to maxWidth; measure reports the width drawn
- presence is Rich's `if self.title` on the content as given: markup that
  styles nothing is a two-space label in Panel/Rule and a blank row in Table
- a cut label is marked only when its own overflow is ellipsis
- labels are read once per renderable (InlineLabel), not per measure
- RichText's piece lookup names empty text's one piece; stale end comment fixed
- docs/panel.md covers width, title widening and label cutting

* fix(panel): widen a label's tabs before it is cut or fitted to (rich-panel-blxr review)

A tab in a panel title or subtitle was measured unexpanded and drawn expanded,
so the border's excess went negative and String.repeat threw. InlineLabel now
expands tabs as Rich's _title does, through a new RichText.expandTabs that
moves spans with their characters.

* fix(panel): measure, cuts and absence follow Rich (rich-panel-blxr review)

Escalation high-pass findings, each against Rich 9d8f9a3:
- measure is Rich's __rich_measure__: a declared width measures as itself,
  and a title counts as content inside padding and frame; render keeps
  Rich's title + 4 floor
- a cut label is set_cell_size'd as Rich's truncate cuts it, so a split
  wide character leaves a space; the ellipsis is ASCII on an ASCII console
- present() asks what content is, so a null title from JS is no label
- drawLabel is the one way a cut label leaves for Panel and Rule

Rule's wide-title parity filed as rich-rule-thri, CR stripping as rich-text-svdg.
